name: Petal path
description: the Petal Path necklace is designed to add a soft floral charm to your everyday style. Featuring tiny flower motifs gracefully placed along a fine gold-toned chain, this anti-tarnish piece blends elegance with minimal beauty. Lightweight and versatile, it pairs effortlessly with both casual outfits and festive looks, making it a timeless addition to your jewellery collection.
